subject: HelioCare assessment: sprint playbook, kickoff timing & final gates
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@heliocare.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: HelioCare assessment: sprint playbook, kickoff timing & final gates

Hi Maria — thanks again for a productive demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed playbook so we have alignment before kickoff. Please confirm owners and any timeline constraints.

High-level goal: validate Redwood inference for HelioCare triage assistant within a 4–6 week evaluation and establish clear go/no-go gates.

Proposed success criteria (agreed on call; please flag exceptions):
- Latency: p95 text-generation response < 400ms at baseline traffic (50 concurrent sessions)
- Cost: inferencing unit economics goal < $0.002 / token for typical request mix
- Fidelity: extracted key-entities/triage-label F1 >= 0.85 versus your labeled holdout
- Operational: reproducible deployment with KV-caching enabled, and non-production data residency in us-west

Minimum deliverables:
1) Shared sample dataset (anonymized) + schema (we discussed NDJSON)
2) Access for our SE (Laura) to a staging endpoint or S3 with read-only creds
3) Weekly check-ins for progress and blockers + final 60-min readout with decision rubric

Tentative timeline (please confirm):
- Data handoff deadline: May 3
- Kickoff (technical + scoping): May 6 (1 hour)
- Weekly check-ins: Thursdays 9:00 AM PT (30 min) starting May 13
- Final readout & recommendation: June 3 (60 min)

Attachments: redwood_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (contains step-by-step sprint playbook, roles, and milestone tracker).

Next steps for HelioCare: confirm Maria/Ethan owners for data and security; confirm whether SOC2 evidence will be provided for the staging environment.

If May 6 is tight on your side I can shift, but would like to lock the weekly cadence today.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@heliocare.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@heliocare.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioCare assessment: sprint playbook, kickoff timing & final gates

Hi Markus — thanks for the clear summary and the playbook PDF. Quick notes from our side:

- We agree with the success criteria; one tweak on fidelity: can we accept F1 >= 0.82 for the first iteration with a target of 0.85 for the second sprint? Our labeled set is somewhat noisy.
- Kickoff is better for us on May 6 afternoon PT; Ethan (Head of ML) will own the data handoff and provide the sample NDJSON.
- Security: our InfoSec will share SOC 2 Type II artifacts for the environment by May 4.

I've attached a small sample (heliocare_sample.ndjson) so Laura can start looking at schema.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will handle the initial model selection and whether any quantization will be used?

Thanks,
Maria Alvarez
Director of Product — HelioCare
maria@heliocare.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Maria Alvarez <maria@heliocare.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioCare assessment: sprint playbook, kickoff timing & final gates

Nice recap — looping in operational owners and proposed assignments so everyone has visibility.

Owners / immediate actions:
- Laura Bennett (Solutions Engineering): technical onboarding, dataset validation, model variant selection, run first inference & baseline metrics — target complete by May 10.
- Rishi Malhotra (Sales): procurement/contracting point — will confirm next steps on pilot terms and any MSA addendum.
- HelioCare: Ethan Brown to provide data access and schema (no PHI; confirm anonymization) by May 3.

I'll create a shared Drive folder and enable editor access for Laura & Ethan. I'll also circulate a 1-page onboarding checklist to track the handoffs (attached).

Proposed meeting cadence (slightly updated):
- Kickoff: May 6, 11:00 AM PT (moved from afternoon to late morning to accommodate our SE) — 60 minutes
- Weekly check-ins: Thursdays 9:00 AM PT, 30 minutes, starting May 13
- Final readout: June 3, 9:00 AM PT — 60 minutes (decision rubric + recommendation)

Question for Maria: do you want the final readout to include your engineering leads for deployment feasibility? If so, please list names to include.

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@heliocare.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioCare assessment: sprint playbook, kickoff timing & final gates

Perfect — thanks everyone. Confirming the following:

- Kickoff: May 6, 11:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent) — meeting link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=helio-kickoff-20270506
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/heliocare-redwood-trial (Laura / Ethan / Grace have access)
- SE lead: Laura Bennett will perform first-pass model selection and will test a quantized variant if it reduces latency without dropping F1 below the agreed gate.
- Final readout plan: 60-min slot on June 3 with a 15-min exec summary, 30-min demo + metrics, 15-min recommendations & next steps. The decision rubric is in the playbook (pass/fail per gate).

I've attached the milestone_tracker.csv so we can update ownership and completion dates during weekly check-ins.

See you all on the 6th.

Best,
Markus Klein
